answer: Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the echo of the next round. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the terrace is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
